summary: Optimization: Migrate Video Engine to expo-video (fix_7)

details.user_story: As a Developer, I want to use the modern expo-video engine so that I can avoid deprecation warnings while maintaining sub-millisecond skeleton sync.
details.context: Initial migration failed due to inconsistent timeUpdate events. Implementing explicit timeUpdateEventInterval to match 60fps tracking requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Remove all expo-av dependencies and imports.
Verify 'Clock Pulse' logs appear in the terminal during playback.
Ensure SkeletonOverlay aligns correctly in both Card and Fullscreen modes.
